verdict.rationale: Orb documents managed daily exports of resource types to external data destinations and revenue-recognition exports for financial systems, which covers subscriptions/invoices/usage record portability. However, there is no evidence addressing exporting or porting stored payment methods to another provider — Orb's migration guide only discusses importing data FROM Stripe, not exporting payment credentials out to a new processor. Missing for 10: evidence of payment-method export/portability, explicit invoice/subscription export formats guaranteed for migration-out scenarios, and any documentation of an 'exit' or offboarding data-export workflow.
